description: Henrico, VA – A new report from the Virginia Mercury details how Congressman Rob Wittman spent nearly two decades in Washington voting more than 60 times to repeal the Affordable Care Act. Having once bragged about his voting record to slash healthcare coverage, Wittman is now attempting to hide behind a single vote earlier this year to extend the subsidies.
